name: angled offset diagram with live readout
looks: A mono data readout ("ROLLED OFFSET: SET / ROLL / RESULT") builds line by line on the left as a 3D-looking angled rod diagram draws on the right, its vertices marked with angle dots and dimension lines. A big result number in the accent colour rolls up at the bottom as the last value locks in.
build: DOM mono text lines keyed in top to bottom, each a fixed delay after the last; the diagram is an SVG path with vertex dots and dimension leaders fading in once the segment they describe is drawn; the result number is a blurred digit roll-up similar to a data-infographic counter, landing in the accent colour.
sound: A tick per readout line, a soft chime as the result number locks.
prompt: Build a technical readout line by line beside a diagram that draws itself to match it: a rod or path bending at a measured angle, with dimension leaders and angle markers appearing as each segment completes. Land on a single result number in the accent colour as the readout's payoff.
